\begin{definition}[Metric]
A function $d : X \times X \to [0,\infty)$ is a *metric* if $d(x,y) = 0 \iff x = y$.
\end{definition}

\begin{lemma}
If $x_n \to x$ then every subsequence converges to $x$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{proof}
Fix $\varepsilon > 0$ and pick $N$ with $d(x_n, x) < \varepsilon$ for $n \ge N$. Since $n_k \ge k$,
$$d(x_{n_k}, x) < \varepsilon \quad \text{for } k \ge N.$$
\end{proof}
